single_controlled_change.reason_for_top_quartile: give simultaneous gradient to the critical tail without dilution by easy edges or the single-edge bottleneck of max loss
single_controlled_change.reason_for_rate_pool: penalize early placement of long packets that near-optimal nested chains stably place later
